name: exp_x2ma_jfatl
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system combined with the JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and JFATL confirms the trend direction, and enters short positions on the reverse condition. The system applies a systematic approach with configurable parameters for MA periods, JFATL settings, and risk management.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉系统结合JFATL（Jurik快速自适应趋势线）指标来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且JFATL确认趋势方向时做多，反之做空。系统采用系统化方法，提供可配置的均线周期、JFATL参数和风险管理设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是双均线交叉结合JFATL趋势线确认的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线发生金叉或死叉，同时JFATL指标方向与交叉方向一致作为过滤确认，从而减少虚假信号。出场条件通常包括反向交叉信号触发平仓，或达到止损/止盈目标。仓位管理方面，EA提供手数配置参数，支持固定手数交易。资金管理方面，通过止损设置控制单笔风险，但具体的止损机制依赖于参数配置的合理性。整体策略逻辑清晰，双确认机制有效降低了震荡行情中的假突破风险，但在震荡市中仍可能产生连续亏损信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system combining dual moving average crossover with JFATL trend line confirmation. Entry conditions require a golden cross or death cross between fast and slow moving averages, with JFATL direction matching the crossover direction as a filter to reduce false signals. Exit conditions typically include closing positions on reverse crossover signals or hitting stop-loss/take-profit targets. Position sizing relies on configurable lot size parameters, supporting fixed lot trading. Money management controls per-trade risk through stop-loss settings, though the effectiveness depends on reasonable parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear, and the dual-confirmation mechanism effectively reduces the risk of false breakouts in choppy markets, but consecutive losing signals can still occur during ranging conditions.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 双确认机制（均线交叉+JFATL方向过滤）有效减少虚假信号
策略逻辑清晰简洁，易于理解和调优
趋势行情中表现良好，能捕捉较长的趋势波段
pros_en: Dual confirmation mechanism (MA crossover + JFATL direction filter) effectively reduces false signals
Clear and concise strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing extended trend moves
cons: 震荡行情中容易产生连续虚假信号导致亏损
默认止损止盈为零，存在未设置风控的风险
缺乏动态仓位管理机制，固定手数无法根据波动率调整风险
cons_en: Prone to consecutive false signals and losses in ranging/choppy markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, posing risk of uncontrolled losses without proper configuration
Lacks dynamic position sizing, fixed lots cannot adjust risk based on market volatility
improvements: 增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或ATR阈值），在低趋势强度时减少交易频率
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add a ranging market filter (e.g., ADX or ATR threshold) to reduce trading frequency during low trend strength periods
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and position sizing to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，若用户未手动配置则面临无限亏损风险
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
震荡行情中缺乏过滤机制，可能连续亏损
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, posing unlimited loss risk if not manually configured
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
No ranging market filter, potentially leading to consecutive losses in choppy conditions
